$shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$lnk = $shell.CreateShortcut('a.lnk')
$lnk.TargetPath = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'Ujwalam.cmd'
$lnk.TargetPath = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'ujwalam-start.exe'
$lnk.TargetPath = 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe'
$lnk.TargetPath = 'x.cmd' # console window: the user asked for a terminal here
Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'a.mjs'
Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'a.mjs' -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Process python.exe -NoNewWindow
Start-Process explorer.exe $dir
